text: Intensive Monthly Paid Small Group is designed for those who decide to make full use of their time to enrich their Mandarin in a short period. You will immerse yourselves five days?a week with minimum 2 (3 or 4) lessons per day, and manage your Mandarin with ease in daily life after completion. Program Structure – 50 Minutes per lesson – 3-8 students per class – 2 (3 or 4) teaching hours per day and 5 days per week from Monday to Friday – Guarantee of high teaching and service quality – Classmates from all over the world
